name: Love & Hauntings
source:
As you arrive in New Zealand, your mind is overwhelmed with conflicting thoughts. You hear voices in your head – and outside your head, too. Which voice will you heed?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你来到新西兰时，纷乱矛盾的念头一股脑儿涌上心头。你听见脑子里有人说话——脑子外面也有。你会听从哪个声音？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
